name: Agfa Vista 200
description: A red-forward, punchy Classic Negative recipe that recreates the cult UK drugstore look of Agfa Vista 200: warm saturation, crisp contrast, crunchy grain.

name: Astia 100F
description: An accurate Astia 100F emulation: gentle slide contrast with real midtone snap, faithful-but-flattering skin, and delicate pastel highlights.

name: CineStill 50D
description: A clean, luminous Eterna recipe emulating CineStill 50D: near-grainless, airy highlights and delicate warm-neutral colour for golden-hour fine-art work.

name: Fujicolor C200
description: Fuji's honest budget negative: cool, clean greens with a slight cyan lean, neutral skin and fine grain, built on Classic Negative with a cool WB shift.

name: Harman Phoenix 200
description: An anti-Portra Eterna Bleach Bypass recipe chasing Harman Phoenix 200: high contrast, red-leaning halation, teal shadows and coarse Strong grain.

name: Ilford Delta 3200
description: A high-ISO Acros monochrome recipe with Strong/Large grain and open shadows, built for concerts, bars and available-darkness night streets where grain is the subject.

name: Kodak ColorPlus 200
description: A flat, humble Classic Negative recipe that mimics Kodak ColorPlus 200: warm but not golden, lifted blacks, muted skies, and honest budget grain.

name: Kodak ProImage 100
description: A warm, budget-Portra portrait recipe on Pro Neg Std with a +3 Red / −2 Blue shift and modest contrast — richer skin than Portra 160 without the pastel wash.

name: Kodak T-Max 400
description: A clean, fine-grained ACROS recipe emulating Kodak T-Max 400: cooler tonality, precise mid-greys and high edge sharpness for a technical documentary black-and-white look.

name: Kodak Vision3 250D
description: A clean, halation-free Eterna recipe emulating Kodak Vision3 250D (5207): soft daylight contrast, huge highlight latitude, neutral-warm skin and muted-but-alive colour.

name: Vision3 500T
description: A restrained Eterna night-cinema recipe emulating Kodak Vision3 500T: cool teal shadows, warm orange practicals, tight grain, DR400 open blacks.

name: Natura 1600
description: A grain-forward, ambient-warm Classic Negative recipe for available-darkness night snapshots — Fujifilm's take on the cult Natura 1600 colour negative.

name: Polaroid 600
description: A faded Polaroid 600 look for Fujifilm: milky lifted blacks, washed pastel colour and very soft detail built on Nostalgic Negative.

name: Provia 100F
description: A crisp Provia recipe tuned to the real Provia 100F slide film: true slide contrast, clean cool-neutral colour, and deep grainless primaries.

name: Velvia 50
description: A slide-accurate Velvia 50 recipe: maximum colour density, inky shadows and cool-magenta blues on the Velvia base — meter carefully or lose the frame.

name: Astia Soft Portrait
description: A flattering natural-light portrait recipe on Astia with −3 Clarity, softened highlights and a warm WB shift for smooth skin tones.

name: CineStill 400D
description: A soft, warm-neutral Eterna recipe emulating CineStill 400D for golden daylight streets and portraits — DR400 highlights, lifted shadows, fine grain.

name: Eterna Bleach Bypass: Gritty Cinematic
description: A drained, high-contrast Eterna Bleach Bypass recipe with metallic highlights and heavy mood — built for rain, concrete and night streets.

name: Superia X-Tra 400
description: A Classic Negative recipe emulating Fujifilm Superia X-Tra 400: cool teal-leaning greens, magenta-tinged shadows and honest everyday grain for a composed family-album look.

name: Ilford HP5 Plus 400
description: A flat, forgiving Acros+Yellow black-and-white recipe that emulates Ilford HP5 Plus 400 for overcast light, with soft grain and open shadows.

name: Kodak Ektachrome E100
description: A clean, cool-neutral Provia recipe emulating Kodak Ektachrome E100: precise blues, tight contrast, delicate highlight roll-off for daylight travel and editorial landscapes.

name: Kodak Portra 800
description: A warm, punchy Classic Negative recipe emulating Kodak Portra 800 for tungsten and mixed evening light, with STRONG large grain and DR400 to hold skin under dim conditions.

name: Kodak Portra 160
description: A clean, low-saturation Pro Neg Std recipe emulating Kodak Portra 160: flat contrast, fine grain and cool-neutral skin for studio and bright-daylight portraits.

name: Kodak Ektar 100
description: A crisp, nearly grainless travel and landscape look emulating Kodak Ektar 100 — Velvia dialed back with Color −2 and a warm +2 Red shift.

settings.name: ISO
settings.value: Auto, base ISO 200 up to ISO 1600

name: Kodak Tri-X 400 (Box Speed)
description: A medium-contrast Acros+G recipe emulating box-speed Tri-X 400: rich mid-greys, forgiving highlights and pronounced organic grain for documentary and portrait work.

name: Nostalgic Negative Golden Hour
emulates: 1970s Kodak amateur color / faded print stock
description: A warm, low-key Nostalgic Negative recipe for late sun — amber highlights, cocoa shadows and muted saturation that echo 1970s American color photography.

name: Pro 400H
description: An airy, minty-highlight Astia recipe emulating discontinued Fujifilm Pro 400H, shot a stop over for luminous pastel skin.

name: Pro Neg Hi Editorial Portrait
description: A crisp Pro Neg Hi recipe for directed portraits and lookbooks — precise skin, restrained colour, and a touch more punch than Pro Neg Std in controlled light.

name: Honest Daylight Provia
description: A restrained Provia recipe for accurate-but-warm everyday color: believable skies, neutral skin, and a gentle +1 Red shift that keeps daylight true to memory.

name: Velvia Vivid Landscape
description: A punchy Velvia landscape recipe with DR400, +1 Color and Color Chrome Effect Strong for saturated foliage and rich clear skies at golden hour.

name: Acros Street: Documentary Black & White
description: A punchy Acros recipe built for street work — deep blacks, visible grain, and enough highlight headroom to keep shop windows and bright signs from clipping.

name: Overcast Moody
description: A muted, slightly cool Classic Chrome recipe built for overcast city days — deep shadows, restrained colour, and the documentary weight grey light deserves.

name: Eterna Overcast
emulates: Eterna cinema stock under flat daylight
description: A soft cinematic Eterna recipe for overcast and lightly rainy days — lifted shadows, low saturation, and a cool cast for wet streets and muted architecture.

name: Kodak Gold 200
description: A warm, lightly grainy Kodak Gold 200 emulation built on Classic Negative — friendly skin, golden afternoon light, and saturated blue skies.

name: Kodak Ultramax 400
description: A warm, friendly Classic Negative recipe emulating Kodak Ultramax 400: soft skin, visible grain, and that everyday consumer-film glow.

name: Reala Ace Mixed Light
description: A restrained, cinematic Reala Ace recipe built for the situations where Portra is too daylight-warm and Classic Chrome is too contrasty — mixed indoor/outdoor afternoon light. X-Trans V exclusive.

name: CineStill 800T
description: A tungsten-balanced Classic Chrome recipe that emulates CineStill 800T for night and neon — cool teal shadows, warm streetlights, and heavy cinematic grain.

name: Kodachrome 64
description: A punchy Classic Chrome recipe emulating Kodachrome 64 — rich reds, deep blues, crisp contrast and the timeless National Geographic daylight look.

name: Kodak Portra 400
description: A warm, gentle Classic Negative recipe that emulates Kodak Portra 400 — soft contrast, honest skin tones, and a golden lean for portraits and travel.
